setup.reason: Frozen configuration, prompt and pre-launch source hashes match; baseline source and TASK bytes verified. Retained session matches stdout thread ID and fixture cwd, and identifies CLI 0.154.0. Complete inventory verifies capture. Guidance contains native system skills and the intended target condition, without DD or controller criteria. Complete CW text appears in a tool response before editing.

criteria.reason: As in the first briefing control, the six teams appear only in past-week evidence; the source permission for those teams to continue is omitted. The opening also recommends inviting four teams if checks pass, whereas the source leaves that invitation decision open for Thursday. Approval conditions remain later, so this is changed stance rather than evidence of an unauthorized real invitation. Other facts and limits survive.
criteria.consequence: Functional failure; overlapping defects count once per execution.

criteria.reason: Evidence, prerequisites and follow-up are concise and purposeful. Consolidating the repeated reminders is acceptable in this short briefing; no particular recap is mandatory.
The document provides a coherent evidence-to-conditions path and a clear follow-up. F1 captures the omitted permission and changed stance; no distinct reading obstacle is demonstrated.

The subject reads the complete source, saves a locally tightened and globally reorganized draft, then receives the full Git diff against the baseline before finalizing (session lines 29–48). The comparison occurred even though it did not catch the F1 loss.
